tools.name: steps_to_calories
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how many calories a number of steps burns, such as "10000 steps calories burned 70 kg", "how many calories in 5000 steps" or "calories burned walking 8000 steps brisk". Do not use for running, cycling or gym workouts, children, or medical exercise plans.

tools.name: steps_to_burn
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how many steps or how long a walk it takes to burn a food or calorie amount, such as "steps to burn a samosa", "how much walking to burn 1 roti" or "steps to burn 300 calories 75 kg".
